prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished, highly legible 1920x1080 landscape game UI concept image for the C-key interaction menu in Nuclear Option / Boscali Summer. Replace it with the design described below. The flight scene should remain clearly visible around a compact central interface. No neon glow, holograms, bevels, pills, decorations, dashboard cards or full-screen tint. Header above: 'INTERACTION'. Small central detail 'FLIGHT' and 'Aircraft handling'. Footer below wheel exact 'HOLD C  Select & release     TAP C  Click mode     ESC  Close'. Keep labels upright and horizontal, no rotated type. Show manageable size compared with cockpit.
